pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.
   C. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   D. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.
   B. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.
   C. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   C. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   D. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   C. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.
   C. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Administration of Zakat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Divorce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Care for widows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Governance in Islam Leadership in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. A — Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

10. A — Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Administration of Zakat; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Types of Divorce; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Care for widows; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Governance in Islam Leadership in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
